title: OIDCSession contains session details for a current login.

created_at.description: CreatedAt is when the session was started.

email.description: Email is the email of the user that holds the session.

expires_at.description: ExpiresAt is when the session will expire.

ip.description: IP is the IP address of the user that holds the session.

user_agent.description: UserAgent is the UserAgent of the user that holds the session.

username.description: Username is the name of the user that holds the session.
